title: 18 The Train Station · 火车站的夜班

sents.t: Fernando Victor works at a train station.
sents.zh: Fernando Victor 在一个火车站工作。

sents.t: What he does there specifically is unknown, but regardless of his task, he always seems to have late-night shifts.
sents.zh: 他具体做什么不清楚，但不管做什么，他似乎总是上深夜班。

sents.t: However, it was during a late-night shift when Fernando captures something terrifying on camera.
sents.zh: 然而，就是在一次深夜班上，Fernando 拍到了可怕的东西。

sents.t: Fernando and two other workers are walking beside a train that isn't in operation when, all of a sudden, he captures this without even noticing.
sents.zh: Fernando 和另外两名工人走在一列停运的火车旁，突然，他在毫无察觉的情况下拍到了这个。

sents.t: Someone or something appears to be looking at Fernando as he records them.
sents.zh: 在他拍摄时，好像有人或某种东西在看着 Fernando。

sents.t: What do you think this might have been?
Viewers believe that this may have been the ghost of someone who was involved in a railroad accident.
sents.zh: 观众认为，这可能是某个死于铁路事故的人的鬼魂。

sents.t: Now, it could be that this was actually a person, but if it were, then how come this supposed person looks so creepy?
sents.zh: 当然，这也可能真是一个人，但如果是人，为什么看起来这么吓人？

sents.t: I don't know, but whoever this is looks too dead to be alive.
sents.zh: 我不知道，但不管这是谁，看起来都太像死人，不像活人。

sents.t: Whoever or whatever this is remains a mystery.
sents.zh: 这到底是谁、是什么，仍然是个谜。
